# anypoint_managed_omni_gateway (Resource)

Creates and manages a CloudHub 2.0 Managed Omni Gateway instance.

This is a **managed** (CloudHub 2.0-hosted) Omni Gateway. For a **self-managed** (customer-hosted) Omni Gateway, use [`anypoint_self_managed_omni_gateway`](self_managed_omni_gateway.md) instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anypoint_managed_omni_gateway" "gateway" {
  organization_id = var.root_org
  environment_id  = var.environment_id
  name            = "prod-omni-gw"
  target_id       = var.private_space_id
  release_channel = "lts"
  size            = "small"

  ingress {
    forward_ssl_session = true
    last_mile_security  = true
  }

  properties {
    upstream_response_timeout = 15
    connection_idle_timeout   = 60
  }

  logging {
    level        = "info"
    forward_logs = true
  }

  tracing {
    enabled = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The environment id where the gateway is deployed.
- `name` (String) The name of the gateway.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization id where the gateway is deployed.
- `target_id` (String) The target (private space) id to deploy this gateway to.

### Optional

- `desired_status` (String) The desired runtime status of the gateway (e.g. started, stopped).
- `ingress` (Block List, Max: 1) Ingress configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--ingress))
- `logging` (Block List, Max: 1) Logging configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--logging))
- `properties` (Block List, Max: 1) Runtime properties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--properties))
- `release_channel` (String) The Omni Gateway release channel. Valid values: lts, edge. Defaults to `lts`.
- `runtime_version` (String) The Omni Gateway runtime version. Auto-selected by the platform if omitted.
- `size` (String) The gateway instance size. Valid values: small, large. Defaults to `small`.
- `tracing` (Block List, Max: 1) Distributed tracing configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tracing))

### Read-Only

- `api_limit` (Number) The API limit assigned to this gateway.
- `date_created` (String) The gateway creation date.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this gateway.
- `last_updated_platform` (String) The last time the gateway was updated on the platform.
- `status` (String) The current deployment status of the gateway.
- `target_name` (String) The name of the target (private space).

<a id="nestedblock--ingress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ingress`

Optional:

- `forward_ssl_session` (Boolean) Whether to forward SSL sessions. Defaults to `true`.
- `last_mile_security` (Boolean) Whether to enable TLS to the upstream (last mile security). Defaults to `true`.

Read-Only:

- `internal_url` (String) The internal ingress URL.
- `public_url` (String) The public ingress URL.

<a id="nestedblock--properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `properties`

Optional:

- `connection_idle_timeout` (Number) Connection idle timeout in seconds. Defaults to `60`.
- `upstream_response_timeout` (Number) Upstream response timeout in seconds. Defaults to `15`.

<a id="nestedblock--logging"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logging`

Optional:

- `forward_logs` (Boolean) Whether to forward logs to Anypoint Monitoring. Defaults to `true`.
- `level` (String) Log level. Valid values: debug, info, warn, error. Defaults to `info`.

<a id="nestedblock--tracing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tracing`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether distributed tracing is enabled. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# In order for the import to work, you should provide the gateway ID:
#  {GATEWAY_ID}
# NOTE: organization_id and environment_id are not part of the import ID and must be set in the resource config.

terraform import \
  -var-file params.tfvars.json \       #variables file
  anypoint_managed_omni_gateway.gateway \  #resource name
  aa1f55d6-213d-4f60-845c-201282484cd1 #gateway id
```
